newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 31.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British embassy in Saudi Arabia appoints Saudi lawyer to defend two British nurses charged with murdering an Australian nurse.
- Tunisian exports increased four percent in the first 11 months of 1996, study shows.
- Yemen's unemployment around nine percent in 1994, study.
- Jordan buys 4.5 million tonnes of Iraqi oil.
- Qatari Rasgas Company borrows $2.55 billion to partly finance a $7 billion liquefied natural gas project.
